clips.title: The story
paras: At Mulgore’s Wildmane Water Well, one last cleansing remains. Mull Thunderhorn prepares a totem for the northern well after the Winterhoof and Thunderhorn wells are cleansed.

The Wildmane Water Well still needs cleansing. Goblin ventures have poisoned the land and fouled Mulgore’s scarce water, so the tauren turn to sacred ritual against the blight. After the Winterhoof and Thunderhorn wells are cleansed, Mull Thunderhorn crafts a final totem for the well north of Thunder Bluff. Infused with natural spirits, it purifies the fetid water so life can nourish the plains again.
